title: Common Birds Are Vanishing Too: 2.9 Billion Lost
hook: Common birds aren't protected by being common: 2.9 billion breeding birds vanished.
closing: Bird decline is not confined to rare species; familiar flocks can disappear while they still seem ordinary.
question: Which birds have disappeared from your neighborhood?

segments.say: Breeding bird abundance fell by 2.9 billion between the supplied measurements. The loss extends beyond a few rare species.
Grassland birds declined 53% in the supplied comparison. Waterfowl increased, so the losses were not uniform across groups.
Common bird families account for 90% of the total loss. Familiarity did not protect their populations from shrinking.
